mapper.update: UPDATE payment_outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRYING' END, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, last_failure_type = #{failureType}, first_failed_at = COALESCE(first_failed_at, #{failedAt}), dead_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN #{failedAt} ELSE NULL END, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND lock_until >= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_outbox_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM payment_outbox_event WHERE status = 'DEAD' ORDER BY dead_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_outbox_event SET status = 'RETRYING', attempt_count = 0, next_retry_at = #{now}, dead_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'DEAD'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_outbox_operation_audit (event_id, operator, reason, from_status, to_status, request_id, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{requestId}, #{createdAt})
